title: Fault-aware decoder integration
integration_rule: BT1613 decoded frames are promoted to PASS/CORRECTED/ABORTED outcomes with CSS row and Pauli-frame update fields.
summary: Fuses sequence-level decoder with the parallel fault-path ABI shape while remaining a deterministic synthetic integration test.
honesty_boundary: Synthetic deterministic fault profile only; not measured hardware fault distribution or full decoder simulation.
